summary: James spoke at JVP's 2020 "Free All Prisoners from Rikers Island to Palestine" rally, a personal action linking Palestinian and domestic mass incarceration. In 2026, MAPA endorsed her for governor citing her willingness to speak about connections between militarism, genocide, and war, and Vote for Peace rates her an Ally. Her campaign platform otherwise centers on abolition rather than Israel-Palestine policy.
